DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お花をお探しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年の桜の写真を見て来ました。でも同じ木に花がほとんどありません。今日見られる花はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧年桜写真と違い今日咲く花を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came after seeing a photo of last year’s cherry blossoms. But there are hardly any flowers on the same tree. Are there any flowers I can see today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what flowers are blooming today, unlike in last year’s cherry blossom photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの桜は今、花の時期が終わっています。北の花壇には、今咲いている花があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The cherry blossom season is over for these trees now. There are flowers blooming now in the northern flower bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 去年の写真の月だけ見て、今年も同じだと思っていました。写真の日付と今日の様子は分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧年写真月と今年現状を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the month of last year’s photo and assumed it would be the same this year. I’ll consider the photo’s date separately from how things look today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the month of last year’s photo from the current conditions this year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 北の花壇では、チューリップをご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see tulips in the northern flower bed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日はチューリップを見たいです。友人にも今日の花の写真を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今のチューリップを見て当日の写真を撮ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I’d like to see the tulips today. I’ll also send my friend photos of today’s flowers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will see the tulips currently blooming and take photos today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花壇へは、中央の園路からお進みください。花の間へは入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please take the central park path to the flower bed. Please do not go in among the flowers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 中央の園路から見るのですね。花壇の手前で止まって、花を入れて写真を撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中央の園路から花壇へ入らず花を撮ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should view them from the central park path. I’ll stop before the flower bed and take photos with the flowers in them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph the flowers from the central park path without entering the flower bed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の桜の時期については、その年の開花の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: For the next cherry blossom season, please check the flowering information for that year.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次は写真の月だけで決めず、開花の案内を見ます。今日は中央の園路でチューリップを見に行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次年は開花案内を確認し今日は指定花壇へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Next time, I’ll check the flowering information instead of deciding just by the month of a photo. Today I’ll go along the central park path to see the tulips.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the flowering information next year, and head to the designated flower bed today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ今の季節の花をお楽しみください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23221-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the flowers of the current season. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble with your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 太田川駅から乗りますが、かばんの持ち手が長いまま戻りません。人の足に当たりそうなので、乗る前に置き方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 伸縮持手が戻らず乗車前運搬を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I’m boarding at Otagawa Station, but my bag’s handle is stuck extended. It looks as if it might hit people’s legs, so I’d like advice on how to position it before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about carrying your luggage before boarding because the telescopic handle will not retract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、いったん止まってください。ご自身でかばんを持ち上げられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please move clear of the passage and stop for a moment. Can you lift the bag yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の固定した取っ手なら持てます。重さも一人で持てる範囲です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 固定取っ手で一人で運べると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can hold it by the fixed handle on top. It’s also light enough for me to carry alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you can carry it alone using the fixed handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 機構の修理はできませんが、周囲に当てない運び方を一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot repair the mechanism, but we can check together how to carry it without hitting anything or anyone nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。片手で固定した取っ手を持ち、もう一方で長い部分を自分の体側へ向けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己体側へ長部を向け保持する方法を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me with that. I’ll hold the fixed handle with one hand and use the other to point the extended section toward my body.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe holding it with the long section directed toward your body. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 列車へ入る時は、扉やほかの方に引っ掛からないようご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When entering the train, please take care not to catch it on the doors or other passengers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 扉に引っ掛けそうで心配です。人が少し進んでから、間を空けて乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 扉への引掛かりを心配し間を空けて乗ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I’m worried it might catch on the door. I’ll let people move forward a little, then leave some space as I board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you are worried about catching it on the door and will leave a gap when boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車内でも通路へ突き出さないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep it from sticking out into the aisle on the train too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 端を人へ向けず持ちます。修理は後で相談し、今は周囲を見ながらゆっくり運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 車内通路へ突出さず後で修理相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I’ll hold it without pointing the end at anyone. I’ll ask about repairs later; for now I’ll carry it slowly while watching my surroundings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it out of the train aisle and ask about repairs later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ無理のないようお運びください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please carry it without overexerting yourself. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 市民展示についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the community exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この写真を見て元気が出ました。作者へ感想を届ける方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真への感想を作者に届ける方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This photograph cheered me up. Is there a way to send my impressions to the artist?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to send your thoughts about the photograph to its artist. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 主催者が感想を受け取れるか確認できます。どの作品でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can check whether the organizer can accept comments. Which work is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口から二つ目の、朝の空を写した写真です。作者の名前をまだ読めないので、作品名で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚目の朝空写真を作品名で特定したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It’s the second photograph from the entrance, showing the morning sky. I can’t read the artist’s name yet, so I’d like to identify it by the title.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to identify the second photograph, of the morning sky, by its title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作品名は「朝のひかり」です。主催者への伝え方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The title is “Morning Light.” I’ll explain how to contact the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 朝のひかり、ですね。「夜勤が終わった日に見て、気持ちが明るくなった」と書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作品名復唱し夜勤後元気が出た感想を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Morning Light, right. I’d like to write, “I saw it on the day I finished a night shift, and it lifted my spirits.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat the title and say it cheered you up after a night shift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具体的な感想ですね。返事を求める内容でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is a specific impression. Will you be asking for a reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事はなくても大丈夫です。会いたいというお願いではなく、見てよかったという気持ちだけを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 面会返信要求ではなく感謝のみと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It’s fine if there’s no reply. I’m not asking to meet the artist; I just want to say I’m glad I saw it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear you only want to express appreciation, without requesting a meeting or reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も添えて、受付方法を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please include that preference when checking how comments are accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作品名と感想を短くまとめます。書く用紙があるか、主催者に聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作品名と感想をまとめ主催者へ受付用紙を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I’ll briefly put together the title and my comments. I’ll ask the organizer whether there is paper for writing them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put together the title and comments, and ask the organizer for a comment form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの主催者案内をご覧ください。それでは、ご来場ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please look at this organizer information. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 測っている間は、手をこの位置に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please keep your hand in this position while we measure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。指についた物が気になって、手を動かしました。まだ測れていないかもしれないので、お知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定中手を動かしたと未確定結果を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I’m sorry. I was bothered by the thing attached to my finger and moved my hand. I’m letting you know because the measurement might not have been taken yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you moved your hand during measurement and that the result may not yet be established. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで測定の状態を確認します。痛みはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I’ll check the measurement status. Do you have any pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 痛みはありませんが、挟まれている感じが気になります。自分で引き抜かず、続けてよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 痛みなし挟感あり自己抜去せず可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: There’s no pain, but the pinching feeling bothers me. I’d like to ask whether we can continue, rather than pulling it off myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say there is no pain but a pinching sensation, and ask whether to continue without removing it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 装着の状態も確認します。気になる点はお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I’ll also check how it is attached. Please tell me what is bothering you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 光が見えて驚きました。熱くなるのかと思いましたが、今は熱さは感じません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 光から熱を想像したが実熱感なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was startled when I saw the light. I thought it might get hot, but I don’t feel any heat now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the light made you imagine heat, but you do not actually feel any. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 光へのご不安も伺いました。使い方をご説明してから進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I understand your concern about the light too. I’ll explain how it is used before we proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。終わった時に声をかけてもらえますか。いつまで手を置いておけばいいか分かると安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 測定終了の声掛けを頼み待つ時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Could you tell me when it is finished? I’ll feel reassured if I know how long to keep my hand here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to be told when the measurement is finished and check how long to wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わったらこちらからお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We’ll let you know when it is finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。手を支えた位置で待ちます。違和感が強くなったら、勝手に外さず声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支持位置で待ち違和感増せば声掛けすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I’ll wait with my hand in the supported position. If the discomfort gets worse, I’ll call you instead of taking it off myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait in the supported position and call if the discomfort increases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一度、測定の状態を担当に確認してきます。手はこの位置でお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I’ll go and check the measurement status with the person in charge. Please wait with your hand in this position. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道路の様子について、ご相談にいらしたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have come to discuss the condition of the road, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の前の道に物が置かれています。腹が立って、置いた人を名指しする貼り紙を作りましたが、貼る前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 推測名指し貼紙を出す前に道上物を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are things left in the road in front of my home. I got angry and made a notice naming the person who left them, but I’d like advice before posting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about objects in the road before posting a notice naming someone based on a guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どなたが置いたか、ご自身で確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you personally confirmed who left them there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ。近くの家の人だと思っただけです。名前を書きましたが、本人が置くところは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 置主未目撃で近隣と推測したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I only thought it was someone from a nearby house. I wrote their name, but I haven’t seen that person putting them there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not see who left them and only guessed it was a neighbor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、見た状況を分けて伺います。どんな物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let’s separate out what you actually saw. What sort of objects are they?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 段ボール箱が二つ、道路の端にあります。中は見ていません。今朝から置かれたままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱の数と種類と観察時刻を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two cardboard boxes at the edge of the road. I haven’t looked inside. They’ve been there since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the number and type of boxes and when you observed them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 道路の場所や、通行への影響を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me where on the road they are and how they affect passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩く人が車道へ少しよけています。この地図の角のところです。写真も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩行者が車道へよける状況を地図と写真で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: People walking have to move slightly into the roadway. It’s at this corner on the map. Please look at the photo too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use a map and photo to show how pedestrians move into the roadway to avoid them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状況を確認し、相談先や対応の確認をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We’ll check the situation and guide you on whom to contact and how to confirm the response.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。貼り紙は今は出さず、誰の物かも決めつけません。見た箱と通行の様子を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲示せず所有者を断定せず観察内容を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I won’t put up the notice now or assume whose things they are. I’ll explain the boxes I saw and how people are passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not post the notice or assert ownership, and will report what you observed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と通行の様子を担当へ伝えます。ここでお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I’ll tell the person in charge about the location and passage conditions. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物の発送準備について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about preparing a gift for shipping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人へのハンカチを何重にも包んだら、中身よりずいぶん大きくなりました。飾り紙を減らしてから送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小ハンカチ過剰包装を見直してから送りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrapped a handkerchief for my friend in so many layers that it became much bigger than the contents. I’d like to reduce the decorative paper before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about reviewing the excessive wrapping on a small handkerchief before shipping it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身を傷めない準備をご自身でしていただき、梱包状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please prepare it yourself so the contents will not be damaged, and we’ll check the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中身を包んだ紙は残して、外の飾り紙を減らします。家で包み直して持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身を包む部分を残し外の飾り紙を家で減らすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I’ll keep the paper directly wrapping the contents and reduce the decorative paper on the outside. I’ll rewrap it at home and bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the wrapping around the contents and reduce the outer decorative paper at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送の方法は、準備した大きさなどでご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can discuss shipping methods based on the size and other details once it is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今の包装を測った料金と、包み直した後の料金が同じだと決めず、完成してから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 包装完成後サイズ料金を改め確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won’t assume the price based on the current packaging will be the same after rewrapping; I’ll check once it’s finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the size and shipping price again after finishing the packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ差し出さず、準備し直されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you prepare it again instead of handing it over for shipping yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今日は家へ持ち帰ります。飾りのリボンが外に長く出ない形に直し、持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未差出で持帰り長リボンを外へ出さず包直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I’ll take it home today. I’ll fix it so the decorative ribbon doesn’t stick out far and bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take it home without shipping it and rewrap it so no long ribbon sticks out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 贈る相手の宛先も、確かめておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the recipient’s address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛先は控えてあります。包み直して宛先を付けた状態で、また相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 包み直して宛先を付け後日相談に来ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the address written down. I’ll rewrap it, attach the address, and come back for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rewrap it, attach the address, and return another day for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備できましたらお持ちください。それでは、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it in when it’s ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お預かりする現金を数えます。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: I’ll count the cash you are handing over. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。数えている途中に、別の質問をしてしまいました。質問は数え終わってからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 計数中別質問したと謝り終了後にすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I’m sorry. I asked another question while you were counting. I’ll wait until you finish counting to ask it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Apologize for asking another question during counting and say you will ask after it is finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に金額を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. Please let me confirm the amount first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。今は新しい紙幣を追加で出さず、この束だけで確認してください。別の束はかばんの中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別束を追加せず対象一束だけと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I won’t add any more banknotes now, so please check only this bundle. The other bundle is in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that only this one bundle is to be counted, without adding another bundle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認する対象はこちらの束だけですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: So this bundle is the only one we are checking, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、その束です。自分で数えた金額はメモに書いてあります。後で照らし合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象の束を確認し自己金額メモがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, that bundle. I’ve written down the amount I counted myself. I’ll compare it afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the bundle to be checked and say you have a note of your own count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの確認が済みました。お客様のご希望の金額と照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have finished checking. Let’s compare it with the amount you intended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 照合します。自分のメモにある金額と同じか確認してから、さっきの質問をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 計数後自己メモ照合して質問すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I’ll compare them. After checking whether it matches the amount in my note, I’d like to ask my earlier question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will compare the completed count with your note, then ask your question. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 金額は合っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモと同じ金額でした。先ほど聞きたかったのは、控えの受け取り方です。手続きが終わったら、ここで受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額一致を伝え終了後の控えの受取場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It was the same amount as in my note. What I wanted to ask earlier was how to receive my copy. Can I collect it here after the procedure is finished?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the amounts match and ask where to receive your copy after completion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、確認が終わったらこちらでお渡しします。担当へ引き継いできますので、少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we’ll give it to you here once the checks are finished. I’ll hand this over to the person in charge, so please wait a little. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いつもの商品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for your usual product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。毎週買う麦茶が見つかりません。売り切れだと決めて帰る前に、棚が移ったか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: いつもの麦茶不在を売切とせず棚移動を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I can’t find the barley tea I buy every week. Before I assume it’s sold out and go home, could you tell me whether it has moved shelves?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the usual barley tea has moved shelves without assuming it is sold out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今週は、こちらの端の売り場へ移しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This week we have moved it to the display at this end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。端の売り場へ行ってみます。場所が変わったことに気づきませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 移動先を確認し新しい売り場へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I’ll go to the display at the end. I hadn’t noticed that the location had changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the new location and head to the new display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品名はこちらの表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the product name on this label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見つかりました。ただ、いつもの袋より大きいです。棚が合っているから同じ商品と思わず、内容を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新棚発見後大袋を同一品とせず表示確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I found it. But it’s bigger than my usual bag. I won’t assume it’s the same product just because it’s on the right shelf; I’ll check the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After finding the new shelf, check the label instead of assuming the large bag is the same product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量の違う物も、同じ売り場にございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also have different sizes in the same display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい方はどこですか。家の容器が小さいので、いつもの袋を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家の容器に合う小袋の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Where is the smaller one? My container at home is small, so I’d like to buy my usual bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where the small bag that fits your container at home is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さい袋はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありました。この小さい袋を一つ買います。案内していただいて助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望の商品を発見し一袋購入と礼を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here it is. I’ll buy one of these small bags. Your directions really helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you found the product you wanted and will buy one bag, and thank them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お探しの物が見つかってよかったです。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I’m glad you found what you were looking for. Please go to the checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この先もお歩きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you continue walking beyond here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雲が暗くなってきたので、今日は遠くまで行かず戻りたいです。雨が必ず降ると分かったわけではありませんが、傘を持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 傘なし暗雲で降雨断定せず遠出を切上げたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The clouds are getting dark, so I’d like to turn back today instead of going far. I don’t know for certain that it will rain, but I haven’t brought an umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to cut the outing short because of dark clouds and no umbrella, without asserting it will rain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 戻る道は、こちらの園路をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check this park path for the way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この道を戻ります。近道に見える草の中へ入らず、入口まで園路を歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 園路で入口へ戻り草内近道をしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I’ll go back along this path. I won’t go into the grass even though it looks like a shortcut; I’ll follow the park path to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will return to the entrance on the park path without taking a shortcut through the grass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご一緒の方には、戻ることをお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please let your companions know that you are going back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人へ今連絡します。私だけ先に帰ったと思われないよう、今日はここから一緒に戻りたいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人に単独帰宅でなく一緒帰路希望を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I’ll contact my friend now. To avoid them thinking I’ve gone home ahead on my own, I’ll tell them I’d like us to turn back together from here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend you want to return together rather than go home alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 急いで走らなくても大丈夫です。足元に気を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is no need to hurry and run. Please watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人が来るまでここで待ちます。急いで戻ると疲れてしまうので、二人でゆっくり歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の合流を待ちゆっくり帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I’ll wait here until my friend arrives. Rushing back would tire me out, so we’ll walk slowly together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for your friend to join you and return slowly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帰りの際は、お忘れ物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that you have not left anything behind when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人が来ました。荷物もそろっています。今日は短い散歩にして、二人で入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人と荷物を確認し短い散歩を終えて入口へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: My friend is here. We also have all our belongings. We’ll make today’s walk a short one and return to the entrance together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend and belongings are all here, end the short walk, and return to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。それでは、よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23222-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care on your way home. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様が列車の音に驚かれたようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: It looks as though your child was startled by the sound of the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日が初めての電車です。列車が近づくと後ずさりするので、どこで待てばよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初乗車子が音で後退するため待機位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today is their first train ride. They step backward when a train approaches, so please tell me where we should wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to wait because your child, riding for the first time, backs away at the sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ホームの端から離れ、こちらの待合側でお待ちください。お子様の手は離さないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stay away from the platform edge and wait here by the waiting area. Please keep hold of your child’s hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待合側ですね。ここなら子どもも落ち着けそうです。手をつないで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待合側の位置を確認し子と手をつないで待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: By the waiting area, right. My child seems likely to calm down here. We’ll wait holding hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the location by the waiting area and say you will wait holding your child’s hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗る時は、列車が止まり、降りる方が済んでから進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: When boarding, please wait until the train has stopped and the people getting off have finished before moving forward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 降りる方を待ってから進みます。子どもが動けなかったら、次の列車まで待ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 降車後に進むと伝え子が動けなければ次便を待ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We’ll move forward after waiting for people to get off. If my child cannot move, may we wait for the next train?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move after passengers have got off, and ask whether you may wait for the next train if your child cannot move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に乗らず、必要な時は係員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not force yourselves to board, and speak to a staff member if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は時間に余裕があります。乗る前に、列車は止まってから乗ると子どもへ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時間余裕を伝え停止後乗車を子へ説明すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. We have plenty of time today. Before boarding, I’ll explain to my child that we get on only after the train stops.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have time to spare and will explain to your child that you board after the train stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お荷物も、足元をふさがないようにまとめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also keep your luggage together so it does not block the space around your feet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: リュックを背負ったので、片手が空きました。子どもと手をつなぎ、扉へ進めるか様子を見てから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: リュックで手を空け子の様子を見て乗車判断と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I’ve put my backpack on, so one hand is free. I’ll hold my child’s hand and see whether they can move toward the door before deciding to board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have freed a hand by wearing your backpack and will decide whether to board after seeing how your child is doing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、親子でお気をつけて。よいお出かけを。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23223-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please both take care. Have a lovely outing.
